scenes.text: Imagine standing in the absolute middle of the Sahara Desert where for two hundred and fifty miles in every direction, there is nothing but sand.
But right there, completely alone, stood a single Acacia tree, a living miracle that survived by sending its roots deep into the earth.
But in nineteen seventy-three, a driver managed to travel across this empty wasteland and crash directly into the world's most isolated tree.
How is that even statistically possible, so hit that follow button and tell me your thoughts in the comments.
